## Plan

A named, recurring tier of the product: `name`, `description`, and `features` (containsMany StringField).

```ts
import { Plan } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/commerce/plan';

@field plan = linksTo(Plan);
```

Deliberately has no price field of its own. A tier's price changes over time and differs by billing interval, so a consumer keeps prices on its own records that link to the Plan, and finds a Plan's current prices by query rather than through a stored back-link every price change would have to rewrite.

### Non-goals
Does not carry a billing interval or an amount; those belong to the consumer's price records. Not a subscription: a subscription record links the Plan it is on. Service is the sibling for one-time work.

### Example
`Plan/enterprise-tier`, the Enterprise tier with its feature list.
